verses.text:
\s1 Jesus Lamsialsak John  
\r Matt. 3:1-12; Lk. 3:1-18; Jn. 1:19-28
Pathian Tapa Jesus Christ lungdamna thu a kipatna in;
Kamsang te in a sonkholsa bangma in, en vun, na pai natu lampi a pua tu in, ka kamtaipa na mai ah sawl khi hi.
Senneal ngam sungah a au aw khat in, Topa lampi puakhol vun a, tangsak vun, ci hi.
John in senneal ngam ah tuiphumna pia a, mawmaisakna tu in ki sikkik na tuiphumna thu tangko hi.
Jerusalem le Judah ngam theampo pan in mi tampi te John kungah hongpai uh a, amate mawna te pualak in Jordan ngun ah tui ki phum tek uh hi.
John sia kala-uk mul taw a ki tak puan sil a, a kawng sia savun kawngkhau taw kil hi; khaumaw le khuaitui te ne hi;
Ka nung pan hongpai pa sia kei sang in thahat zaw a, kei ka hile kun in a peangdap khau sutsak tu in zong ka kiphu bua hi:

Keima in tui taw tuiphumna kong pia hi: ahizong Ama in Tha Thiangtho taw tuiphumna hong pia tu hi, ci in pualak hi.   
\s1 John in Jesus Tuiphum  
\r Matt. 3:13-17; Lk. 3:21, 22
Tuazawkciang in, Jesus sia Galilee ngam Nazareth pan hongpai in, John in Jordan ngun ah tuiphumna pia hi.
Jesus tuisung pan a thawto pociang, van hong ki hong in, Thaa sia vakhu bang in a tungah hong tuaksuk John in mu hi:

Van pan in aw khat hong nging a, Nangma sia ka it ka Tapa na hihi, Na tungah ka lungkim mama hi, ci hi.   
\s1 Jesus Ze-et na  
\r Matt. 4:1-11; Lk. 4:1-13
Tuazawk pociang in, Thaa in Jesus sia senneal ngam ah paisak hi.

Tua senneal ngam ah ni sawm li om a, Satan in ze-et hi; senneal ngam sung ngamsa te taw omkhawm a; vantung mite in khoi hi.   
\s1 Jesus Nasep Kipan  
\r Matt. 4:12-17; Lk. 5:14, 15
John thong a tak zawkciang in Jesus Galilee ah pai a, Pathian kumpingam lungdamna thuhil hi.

\wj A hun hong cing zo a, Pathian kumpingam hong nai zo hi, na mawna uh kisik vun a, lungdamna thu um vun, \wj* ci hi.   
\s1 Nungzui Masa Te A Sapna  
\r Matt. 4:18-22; Lk. 5:1-11
Jesus Galilee tuili hui ah a pai laitak in Simon le a suapuipa Andrew sia tuili sungah ngenpai in a om laitak mu hi:
Jesus in amate tung ah, \wj Ka nung hong zui tavun, mihing man te kong suaksak tu hi, \wj* ci hi.
Taciang amate in thakhatthu in a ngen te nusia in, a nungzui uh hi.
A khuala hiat na mun a thet uh ciang in Zebedee tapa James le John te u nau ngunkuang sungah ngen a phaw uh laitak mu hi.

Jesus in a mu pociang in sam a; amate zong ngunkuang sungah a pa Zebedee le a naseam te nusia in a nung zui uh hi.   
\s1 Jesus in Doai Ngilo Hawlkhia  
\r Lk. 4:31-37
Amate Capernaum khua ah pai uh a; sabbath ni hong thet pociang synagogue sungah tum in, thuhil hi.
Amate in a hil na lamdangsa tek uh hi: banghangziam cile thukhamhil te bang in hil ngawl in, thunei te khat bang in hil hi.
Amate synagogue sungah doai ngilo vei pasal khat om a,
Nang Nazareth mi Jesus, hong om nginge sak po tan; nang taw bang sep tu nei khu ziam? hong susia tu in hongpai hi ngawl ni ziam? Nangma in Pathian mithiangtho ni hi, ci hong he khi hi, ci au hi.
Tasiaciang Jesus in ama tei a, \wj Om nginge po in a, hisia pa sung pan pusuak in, \wj* ci hi.
Doai ngilo in tuapa huangsak vadil a, a nging tatak a au zawkciang, a sung pan pusuak hi.

Amate theampo in lamdangsa mama uh a, hisia in bangbang hithong ziam? hibang te koibang hil na thak ziam? banghangziam cile thuneina taw thupia in, doai ngilo te nangawn in a thuni hi, ci in amate sungah ki dong tek uh hi.

Taciang a min sia Galilee ngam kimkot teng theampo ah manlangtak in thang hi.   
\s1 Jesus in Mi Tampi Damsak  
\r Matt. 8:14-17; Lk. 4:38-41
Amate synagogue sung pan a pusua zawk uh ciang in, James le John te taw Simon le Andrew te innsung ah tumsuak pai uh hi.
Ahihang Simon zi i a nu sia a cisa in lum hi, ci manlang tak in son uh hi.
Taciang Jesus hongpai a, a ban pan len in kaito hi; tasia pociang in a cisa thai a, amate leangna do hi.
Nitak sang ni tum ciang in, cina te le doai te a kungah puak uh hi.
Tua khuapi sung mihing theampo a kongbiang ah hong ki kaikhawm siat uh hi.

Jesus in natna namcin a thuak te damsak a, doai tam mama hawlkhia hi; Jesus in doai te pausak ngawl hi, banghangziam cile amate in Jesus he uh hi.   
\s1 Jesus Zingtung Tho in Thungen  
\r Lk. 4:42-44
A zingciang khuavak ma in Jesus tho a, khuapua sangah pusuak in kuama om ngawl na mun ah thungen hi.
Amate in a mu uh ciang in, a kungah, mi theampo in hong zong uh hi, ci uh hi.
Jesus in, \wj Khuapi dang te ah zong pai tawng, tuak sungah thuhil tu khi hi: banghangziam cile thuhil tu in hongpai ka hihi, \wj* ci hi.

Galilee ngam mun tatuam synagogue te ah thuhil a, doai te zong hawlkhia hi.   
\s1 Jesus in Miphak Khat Damsak  
\r Matt. 8:1-4; Lk. 5:12-16
Miphak khat ama kungah hongpai a, khupdin in, Topa uk hi po le te keima hong thiangsak thei ni hi, ci in thum hi.
Jesus in tuapa tungah hesuakna nei in, a khut tham a, \wj Uk khi hi; thiang tan, \wj* ci hi.
Jesus in a ci zawkpociang in, a phak natna bo vingveng a, ama thiang hi.
Jesus in ama phatak in thu a vaithak zawkciang, paisak hi;
Ama kungah, \wj Kuama son heak in: ahizong thiampi te kungah pai tan a, nangma le nangma ki lak in, amate tungah tetti na lak natu in Moses thupiak biakpiakna pia in, \wj* ci hi.
Ahihang tua pa pai in, mun theampo ah a pualak kakoai hu in, Jesus khuapi sungah a kilang in tum thei ngawl a, khua pua sang duisung ah om hi: taciang mun theampo pan in a kungah hongpai tek uh hi.

\s1 Jesus in Pumzawpa Damsak  
\r Matt. 9:1-8; Lk. 5:17-26
Tuazawk ni tam ki hal ngawl in Jesus Capernaum khua ah hong theng kik a; inn ah om hi, ci thu hong kison hi.
Tasia pociang in mihing tam mama hong theng tek uh a, innsung ah a awng na munkhat mama zong om ngawl in, kongkha hui a puasang dong in dimteak uh hi: tua mun ah Jesus in amate thuhil hi.
Tualaitak in mihing li in pumzawpa khat zawng khawm uh a, hong paipui uh hi.
Mihing tamlei ahikom in Jesus kung dong pai thei ngawl hi, tua ahikom Jesus om na tungsan pan inn khuvum sulet uh a: pumzawpa a lupna taw khiasuk uh hi.
Jesus in amate upna uh a mu ciang, pumzawpa kungah, \wj Ka tapa awng, na mawna te hong ki maisak zo hi, \wj* ci hi.
Ahihang tua mun ah thukhamhil te pawlkhat tokhawm uh a, amate thinsung uh ah,
Banghang in hisia pa in Pathian mindaisak in pau ziam? Pathian bek in mawna maisak thei hi ngawl ziam? ci in ngaisun uh hi.
Thakhatthu in Jesus in amate ngaisutna a thaa taw he a, \wj Banghang in na thinsung uh ah hi thu te ngaisun nu ziam?\wj*
\wj Hi pumzawpa kungah, na mawna te hong ki maisak zo hi; ci le, tho in a, na lupna zial in, pai in, ci tu koisia ol zaw ziam?\wj*
\wj Ahihang, mihing Tapa in leitung ah mawna te maisak thei na vangletna nei hi, ci na tel thei natu uh in, \wj* (pumzawpa kungah),
\wj Nangma tungah kong ci hi, tho in a, na lupna zial in, pai in a, cia in, hong ci khi hi, \wj* ci hi.

Tasia pociang thakhatthu in tho a, a lupna la in mi theampo i mai ah pai hi; amate theampo in lamdangsa mama uh a, hibang thu i mu ngei bua hi, ci in Pathian minthang pok uh hi.   
\s1 Levi A Sapna  
\r Matt. 9:9-13; Lk. 5:27-32
Jesus tuili hui ah pai kik hi; taciang mihonpi te a kungah hongpai uh a, amate thuhil hi.
Lampi ah a pai uh laitak in Alphaeus i tapa Levi sia shia ki dong na mun innsung ah a to mu a, \wj Hong zui tan, \wj* ci hi. Tasia ciang ama zong ding in, Jesus nungzui hi.
Tuazawkciang in, Jesus Levi innsung anneakna mun ah to hi, siadong te le mawnei tampi te zong Jesus le a nungzui te taw to khawmtek uh hi: banghangziam cile mitampi in a nung pan zui hi.
Taciang siadong te le mawnei te taw an a neak khop uh, thukhamhil te le Pharisee te in a mu uh ciang in, a nungzui te kungah, bangbang in siadong te le mawnei te taw annekhawm ziam? ci uh hi.

Tua thu Jesus in a zakciang in amate tung ah, \wj A cidam te in syavuan kul ngawl hi, ahihang cina te in kul hi: mipha te sam tu in hongpai ngawl khi hi, mawnei te ki sikkiksak tu in hongpai khi hi, \wj* ci hi.   
\s1 John Nungzuite in Antan Thu Dong  
\r Matt. 9:14-17; Lk. 5:33-39
John le Pharisee te zungzui te antang tawntung uh hi: amate Jesus kungah hongpai uh a, John le Pharisee te i nungzui te antang uh hi, banghang in na nungzui te tang ngawl ziam? ci uh hi.
Jesus in amate kungah, \wj Zineipa sia a lawmte taw a om laitak in amate antang thei tu ziam? zineipa om sung theampo antang thei ngawl hi.\wj*
\wj Ahihang amate kung pan zineipa a ki lak ni hong theng tu a, tasiaciang antang kik lai tu hi.\wj*
\wj Puan lui sia puan thak taw kuama in phaw ngei ngawl hi: tabang in phaw le tua a phawna puan thak in puan lui sia kaikin tu a, a ek zai seseam tu hi.\wj*

\wj Tasia bangma in savun um lui sungah kuama in sapittui thak thun ngei ngawl hi: a thun le savun um tamtham tu a, sapittui bua siat in, savun um zong laltham tu hi: ahihang sapittui thak sia savun um thak sungah a thun hamtang tu uh a hihi, \wj* ci hi.   
\s1 Jesus Sabbath i Topa Hi  
\r Matt. 12:1-8; Lk. 6:1-5
Tuazawkciang in, Jesus sabbath ni khat lo sung kantan in pai a; a nungzui te a ngilkial ahikom, zungtang hui te hiat in ne uh hi.
Ahihang Pharisee te in a mu uh ciang, Jesus kungah, en in, na nungzui te in sabbath ngeina a hi ngawl te banghang seam uh ziam? ci uh hi.
Jesus in amate tung ah, \wj David le a lawmte a ngilkial uh a, kisap na a nei ciang in, bang vawt ci thu simngei ngawl nu ziam?\wj*

\wj Thiampi sangbel Abiathar hun lai in Pathian innsung ah bangbang tum in, thiampi te bek i a neak thei, Pathian mai ah a ki lui anluum te ne in, a lawmte zong pia hi ngawl ziam? amate neak tu a kilawm ngawl, thiampi te bek i a neak thei tu in Pathian mai ah a ki lui anluum te ne uh hi, \wj* ci hi.
Tasiaciang Jesus in amate tung ah, \wj Sabbath sia mihing te atu a kivawt hi a, mihing sia sabbath atu in a ki vawt hi ngawl hi:\wj*
\wj Tua ahikom mihing Tapa sia sabbath i tungah Topa a hihi, \wj* ci hi.

\s1 Sabbath Ni in Khutzaw Pa Damsak  
\r Matt. 12:9-14; Lk. 6:6-11
Jesus synagogue sungah tumkik a; tuaksung ah khut langzaw khat om hi.
Ama maw zong nuam te in sabbath ni in damsak maw, damsak ngawl; ci encik uh hi.
Jesus in tua khut langzaw pa tung ah, \wj A maisang ah hong ding tan, \wj* ci hi.

Taciang Jesus in amate tung ah, \wj Sabbath ni in a pha sep tu kilawm ziam maw, a hibale a phangawl sep tu kilawm ziam? ngual nuntakna ngum tu maw, that tuh?, \wj* ci hi. Ahihang amate a huthe bua uh hi.

Jesus in a kimkot teng thin-uk kawm in en a, amate thinpui uh hu in khuangai a, tua pa kungah, \wj Na khut phal in, \wj* ci hi. Tasiaciang ama in a khut phal a: tua a khut sia a langkhat bangma in dam kik hi.

Tasia pociang, Pharisee te pai in Herod mihing te taw Jesus suksiat thei natu thu kikum pai uh hi.   
\s1 Mi Tampi Te in Jesus Zui
Ahihang Jesus a nungzui te taw tuili sangah pai uh a: a zui mihon tampi te sia, Galilee le Judah,
Jerusalem, Idumea le Jordan ngunngal; Tyre le Sidon kim teng pan hongpai te a hi uh hi. Tua mihon tampi te sia Jesus i na lianpi a vawt te a zak uh ciang in, a kungah hongpai tek uh hi.
Mihonpi te in phulcip tha tu a hi ciang in ngunkuang no khat taw ngak khol tu in a nungzui te sawl hi.
Banghangziam cile mi tam mama damsak zo a; natna a thuak te theampo in ama tham tu in kitu ngawp uh hi.
Doai ngilo te in Ama a mu uh ciang in, a mai ah bok uh a, nang sia Pathian Tapa ni hi, ci in au uh hi.

Jesus in amate tung ah, Ama thu kuama hesak ngawl tu in nasiatak in vaitha hi.   
\s1 Jesus In Nungzui Sawm Li Ni te Teal  
\r Matt. 10:1-4; Lk. 6:12-16
Jesus mualtung ah kato hi, taciang Ama i dei te teal a: tua te a kungah hongpai hi.
Mihing sawmleni te sia ama kungah om tu in ahizong, thuhil tu in paisak tu ahizong, nasep pia in,
Natna te damsak tu in ahizong, doai te hawlkhiat zawk na vangletna nei tu in ahizong:
Zebedee tapa James le John; amate sia Boanerges ci in min kivaw a, a khiakna sia vanto tate, cinopna a hihi:
Andrew, Philip, Bartholomew, Matthew, Thomas, Alphaeus tapa James, Thaddaeus, Canaan mi Simon,

Jesus leheakpa Judas Iscariot te a hi uh hi: Taciang amate innsung ah tum tek uh hi.   
\s1 Jesus le Beelzabub  
\r Matt. 12:22-32; Lk. 11:14-23
Taciang mihonpi te hongpai kik uh hi, tua ahikom amate anneak hun zong a nei bua hi.
Tua thu a mealheak te in a zak uh ciang in, Jesus sia a thin-am zo hi, a ci uh hu in Ama pui tu in pai tek uh hi.
Jerusalem pan hongpai thukhamhil te in, Jesus sungah Beelzabub om hi, doai ngilo le topa vang taw in doai te hawlkhia hi, ci uh hi.
Taciang Jesus in amate a kungah sam in, sontena te taw thu son a, \wj Bangbang in Satan in Satan hawlkhia thei tu ziam?\wj*
\wj Kumpingam khat kikhen in kido a hile, tua kumpingam sia kho ngawl tu hi.\wj*
\wj Inn khat sia kikhen in kido a hile, tua inn kho ngawl tu hi.\wj*
\wj Tasia bangma in Satan zong ama le ama kikhen in a kido le, kho ngawl tu a, bo in mangthang tu hi.\wj*
“\wj Kuama in mihing thahatpa hencip masa ngawl in, a innsung ah tum in a neisa te sut thei ngawl tu hi, mihing thahatpa a hencip zawkciang bek in; a innsung van te sut thei tu hi.\wj*
\wj A tatak ka ci ciang, mihing te mawna namcin le sonsiatna te kimaisak tu hi:\wj*
\wj Ahihang Tha Thiangtho a sonsiate, bangmahun in ki maisak ngei ngawl tu hi, banghangziam cile tawntung thukhenna dan thuak tu kilawm hi:\wj* ci hi.

Amate in Jesus sungah tha-nin om hi, a ci uh hu in Jesus in hibang in a pau a hihi.   
\s1 Jesus Nu le A Suapuite  
\r Matt. 12:46-50; Lk. 8:19-21
Tuazawkciang Jesus nu le a nau te hongpai a, a puasang ah ding in, mikhat Jesus kungah sawl in sam hi.
A kim a mihonpi te to a, a kungah, en in, na nu le na nau te nangma zong in a puasang ah om hi, ci hi.
Jesus in, \wj Ka nu, a hibale, ka suapui te kua te ziam?\wj* ci in zo kik hi.
Taciang a kim a pam a to te en in, \wj En vun, ka nu le ka suapui te!\wj*
\wj Banghangziam cile a kuamapo Pathian deina a seam peuma sia, ka suapui le ka nu a hihi, \wj* ci hi.

\s1 Thaici Poai Sontena  
\r Matt. 13:1-9; Lk. 8:4-8
Jesus tuili hui ah thuhil kipan kik hi: a kungah mihon tampi te hong ki kaikhop ciang in tuili sung ngunkuang sungah tuak in to a; mihonpi te sia tuili hui ah om uh hi.
Tasiaciang sontena te zang in thuhil a,
\wj Ngai vun a; en vun, thaici poaipa khat thaici poai tu in pai hi:\wj*
\wj Tabang a poai ciang in, thaici pawlkhat te lampi ah tak a, tungleang te hongpai in ne siat hi.\wj*
\wj Pawlkhat te suang tam na mun ah tak a, lei tawm a hi man in thaici te hong po pai hi, banghangziam cile lei thuk ngawl hi:\wj*
\wj Ni hong sua ciang in, nisa in kang a; zung tha ngawl ahikom ngawtak hi.\wj*
\wj Pawlkhat te lingphung sungah tak a, lingkung te a khan ciang in deapcip in, nga zo ngawl hi.\wj*
\wj A dang te lei pha na tungah tak hi, taciang po in hong khang a, a nga hong nga hi; pawlkhat te a se sawmthum, pawlkhat te a se sawmluk, pawlkhat te a se zakhat dong in khang hi, \wj* ci hi.
Taciang Jesus in amate tung ah, \wj Zak natu bil a nei peuma in za tahen, \wj* ci hi.
Ama nguak a om laitak in, a nungzui sawmleni te taw a omte in sontena thu dong uh hi.
Jesus in amate tung ah, \wj Pathian kumpingam thuku heak theina hong pia zo hi: ahihang a puasang a omte tung ah, tua thu te theampo sia sontena te taw son hi:\wj*
\wj Amate in mu tu hi napi, a he bua tu uh hi; ngai tu hi napi, a tel thei bua tu uh hi; tabang hi bua le hun khatpo ah amate ki kheal in, amate i mawna ki maisak tu hi, \wj* ci hi.
Jesus in amate tung ah, \wj Hi sontena te he ngawl nu ziam? taciang sontena theampo bangbang in tel thei tu nu ziam?\wj*
\wj Thaici poaipa in Pathian kammal poai hi.\wj*
\wj Lampi ah a tak thaici te thu sia hibang te a hihi, amate in Pathian kammal a zak uh ciang in Satan manlang tak in hongpai a, amate thinsung pan Pathian kammal te laksak hi.\wj*
\wj Suang tam na mun ah a tak thaici te sia hibang te a hihi; amate sia Pathian kammal a zak uh ciang in thakhatthu in lungdamna taw sang hi napi;\wj*
\wj Amate sungah zungtha ngawl ahikom, tawmvei sung bek khom hi: Pathian thu hang in haksatna le vawtsiatna a thet ciang in, thakhathu in pukkik hi.\wj*
\wj Lingsung a tak thaici te thu sia hibang te a hihi, Pathian kammal za napi, \wj*
\wj Hi leitung thinngimna, hauna i theamna, nadang tampi te lungngul nate tum in Pathian thu sia deapcip ahikom, a nga toai ngawl hi.\wj*

\wj Lei pha na a tak thaici te thu sia hibang a hihi; Pathian thu za in sang a, pawlkhat te a se sawmthum, pawlkhat te a se sawmluk, pawlkhat te a se zakhat in a nga hong toai hi, \wj* ci hi.   
\s1 Khum taw a ki Khup Khuaimei  
\r Matt. 5:14-16; Lk. 8:16-18
Jesus in amate tung ah, \wj Khuaimei sia khum nuai ah, a hibale, lupna nuai ah koi tu in ki keng ngei ziam? meivak na tungah a ki koi tu hi ngawl ziam?\wj*
\wj Banghangziam cile a ki lang ngawl tu in phualcip thei bangma a om ngawl bangma; pualak ngawl tu thuku zong om ngawl hi.\wj*
Jesus in amate tung ah, \wj Na zak thu uh kidawm vun: ngualdang na te uh bangma in noma zong hong ki tekik tu hi: taciang a za te a tamzaw hong ki piakik tu hi.\wj*

\wj Banghangziam cile a nei te ki pia thua tu a: a nei ngawl te a neisun ki laksak tu hi, \wj* ci hi.   
\s1 Thaici Sontena
Jesus in, \wj Pathian kumpingam sia, mikhat in a lo ah thaici poai tu hi;\wj*
\wj Taciang mu in, le tho in, sun le zan in thaici bangbang in po tu le bangbang in khang tu ci a he ngawl thaici poaipa taw kibang hi.\wj*
\wj Banghangziam cile leitang in ama thu in ngasak a; a masabel in a te meangsak hi, tua zawkciang vui a, a vui zawkciang a tang hong suak hi.\wj*

\wj Ahihang anlak hun hong thet ciang in, ama in phiau taw manlangtak in at hi, banghangziam cile anlak hun cing zo hi, \wj*   
\s1 Ankam Cii Sontena  
\r Matt. 13:31, 32, 34; Lk. 13:18, 19
Jesus in, \wj Kumpingam sia bangtaw sonte tu khi ziam? a hibale bangtaw tekak tu khi ziam?\wj*
\wj Hisia in ankam cii taw kibang hi, lei ah a poai ciang in thaici dang theampo sang in no zaw hi:\wj*
\wj Ahihang a poai zawkciang in hong khang a, an te theampo sung pan a lianbel hong suak hi, van a vacim te a lim ah tawlnga thei zadong in a bak te nei hi, \wj* ci hi.
Amate i zak thei tuh in sontena tampi taw thuhil hi.

Sontena kihel ngawl in amate tungah thuhil ngawl hi: taciang amate bek a om uh ciang in a nungzui te kungah tua thu te son thiang hi.   
\s1 Jesus in Huipi Suangval Thimsak  
\r Matt. 8:23-27; Lk. 8:22-25
Tua ni nitak sang in, Jesus in a nungzui te kungah, \wj Ngalkhat ah pai tawng, \wj* ci hi.
Amate in mihonpi te a paisak zawk uh ciang in, Ama sia nungzui te in ngunkuang taw paipui hi. Tua mun ah a dang ngunkuang no te zong om hi.
Tasiaciang huipi suangval nasiatak in hong tho a, tuihual te in ngunkuang sia nuaicip ahikom, ngunkuang sungah tui hong dim hi.
Jesus sia ngunkuang nungsang kham in mu hi: amate in phong uh a, Syapa awng, ka thisiat tu uh phamaw hong sa ngawl ni ziam? ci uh hi.
Jesus hong tho in, huipi tei hi, taciang tuipi tung ah, \wj Thim in, \wj* ci hi. Taciang hui thim in, dai dide hi.
Jesus in nungzui te kungah, \wj Banghang in hibang lalawm in lau nu ziam? bangbang lalawm in upna nei ngawl nu ziam?\wj* ci hi.
Amate lau mama uh a, hisia pa sia bangbang mihing ziam, hui le tuipi in a thuni hi? ci in khat le khat kici uh hi.

\s1 Jesus in Thin-am Khat Damsak  
\r Matt. 8:28-34; Lk. 8:26-39
Amate tuili ngalkhat Gadarenes ngam theng uh hi.
